config.candidate_rule: 95% percentile CI overlaps the distant-score winner CI
config.plateau_rule: mean distant score over original epochs t-k through t+k, including self
config.fallback_rule: largest permitted k; explicitly mark criterion failure
config.interpretation: Uncalibrated agreement-factor ranking scores, not accuracy probabilities

burnin: Flags from all-partners k0 factor <0.01, or >50% empty/identical strings across images; fixed for bootstrap. Flag all degenerate epochs, report whether early. Excluded epochs inferred afterward, never steer active scores.
bootstrap: 2000 paired image resamples, refit scores; original k/exclusions frozen. Conditional percentile CIs, not selection-adjusted or accuracy CIs.
mode_decomposition: Regional voter-pool modes, not additive decomposition of nonlinear global mode.
joint_fit: Four deterministic starts; log tau bounded 0.05..100*n for numerical stability; boundary solutions reported.
posthoc: Version2 requested after earlier results/labels were inspected. Retrospective evaluation, no thresholds tuned on the 251 labels.
